edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during construction of Owned.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership can execute.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address governs the write target.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller as the approval owner.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the callback.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender equalling owner.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval callback.
Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner back to address(0) after promotion.
GoldInu constructor initialises the symbol state variable.
GoldInu constructor initialises the name state variable.
GoldInu constructor initialises the decimals state variable.
GoldInu constructor mints the full amount into _totalSupply.
GoldInu constructor credits the entire supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as part of its computation.
totalSupply performs an unchecked raw subtraction between supply and burnt balance.
balanceOf returns a value read from the balances mapping.
transfer mutates balances entries through safe arithmetic helpers.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance safely.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance safely.
approve writes the supplied token amount into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances of 'from' and 'to' using safe arithmetic.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance stored in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
allowance returns the nested mapping value for owner and spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the callback.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the untrusted spender contract before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract address.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the privileged owner address as the sweep destination.
